# Vendor icons

These marks identify the provider of a model. They are used only for
identification; all trademarks remain the property of their owners.

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `deepseek.svg` | [Simple Icons — DeepSeek](https://simpleicons.org/?q=deepseek), CC0 |
| `qwen.svg` | [Simple Icons — QWen](https://simpleicons.org/?q=qwen), CC0 |
| `claude.svg` | [Simple Icons — Claude](https://simpleicons.org/?q=claude), CC0 |
| `anthropic.svg` | [Simple Icons — Anthropic](https://simpleicons.org/?q=anthropic), CC0; retained as an alternate mark |
| `stepfun.svg` | [LobeHub Icons — StepFun](https://lobehub.com/icons/stepfun), MIT |
| `openai.svg` | [OpenAI official favicon](https://openai.com/favicon.svg) |
| `moss.svg` | [MOSS / MOSI official favicon](https://mosi.cn/favicon.svg) |
| `gemini.svg`, `grok.svg`, `xai.svg`, `kimi.svg`, `zhipu.svg`, `minimax.svg`, `meta.svg`, `mistral.svg`, `doubao.svg`, `hunyuan.svg`, `baidu.svg`, `cohere.svg`, `perplexity.svg` | [LobeHub Icons](https://lobehub.com/icons), MIT |

The host serves these files read-only from `/dsh-usage/api/vendor/<name>.svg`.
Unknown vendors fall back to a generated two-letter monogram, so a newly used
model never appears blank.
